column1: # Per-eval judge model (GH #510). `claude plugin eval` takes only a run-wide --judge-model
# (default haiku), so a case listed here also gets its own run with --judge-model <model>:
# scripts/eval-changed.sh prints that run, and model-bench-diff.py marks the judgeModel
# mismatch against older haiku-judged history of the case as expected. Read by
# scripts/_lib/eval_judge_models.py; evals/README.md "Judge model" has the decision record.
